ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity pixels (approximately 5-8%) against a dominant low-intensity dark-gray/black background (92-95%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniformly dark pigment base with high-contrast white linear streaks concentrated on the medial-left lobe and small white focal spots on the medial-right lobe. High-intensity clusters are localized at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped notch with sharp vertex transition dividing the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the central trailing edge; transitioning to high-amplitude, irregular peaks (knob-like structures) at the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a broadly concave arc from tips to notch; leading edge (visible at tips) shows convex curvature.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially dense clusters of circular white high-intensity pixel groups localized on the extreme distal tips of both lobes, indicative of barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, non-parallel white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the dark pigment on the left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Substantial white calcified clusters on the distal tips of the fluke; scattered high-contrast scarring across the left lobe.
